title: limonium cantianum
intro: Limonium cantianum, commonly known as Sea Lavender, is a flowering plant native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body and mind. The therapeutic actions of Sea Lavender include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, promote relaxation, and improve sleep quality. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
